description: Versioned updated assessment bank. Legacy exam scores are kept separate.

exams.title: Foundations Mastery Examination — Revised V2
questions: A backup is synced to the same folder and deletes everywhere. What is missing?
A versioned independent backup
A second copy inside the same synchronized folder
An occasional manual copy kept on the same physical device
A synced folder can replicate deletions and corruption. A versioned copy stored independently and tested for restoration avoids sharing that failure.
A filename ends in .pdf.exe. What is the most defensible interpretation?
Possible executable masquerading as document
An ordinary PDF because .pdf appears inside the name
An executable only if the file icon looks unusual
On typical Windows systems .exe is the executable extension; .pdf earlier in the name may disguise intent. The suffix warrants scrutiny, not a conclusion of malware.
What does a simulated terminal's pwd output establish?
The simulator's working directory
The operating system's real current directory
The directory of the remote training server
The Academy simulator returns predetermined educational output, not shell state from your phone or an accessible real machine.
Which is an example of least privilege?
Read-only access to needed reports
Write access to all team files because the trainee is employed there
Administrator access restricted to one named trainee
Least privilege means granting only the reports and actions needed for the stated task, not broad access based on team membership.
Why do unique passwords matter?
Breach reuse is contained
Different passwords guarantee that multifactor authentication is unnecessary
Different passwords prevent reuse and phishing of every session
Unique credentials reduce compromise propagation between services; MFA and phishing-resistant practices still matter.
A message requests a login code urgently. What should you do?
Verify independently; do not disclose the code
Submit the code only when the message names the correct service
Open the attached link to check whether the request is authentic
An unsolicited verification-code request should be treated as suspicious; independently access the legitimate service rather than following the request.

exams.title: Systems and Networks Examination — Revised V2
questions: Two machines are 192.168.40.10 and 192.168.40.20 on /24. Are they generally on the same subnet?
Yes
No, because the final address octets are different
Only if each client has the same router configured
A /24 prefix puts both 192.168.40.x addresses in the same IP network, though that alone does not prove firewall or service reachability.
A name fails to resolve while approved IP connectivity succeeds. Investigate?
DNS
Inspect default gateway settings before reviewing resolver output
Inspect only application-session cookies first
IP connectivity succeeding while hostname resolution fails points to resolver configuration, DNS records or DNS service reachability.
A process uses high CPU after an update. What next?
Identify the process and workload
Restart the process before checking its expected workload
Treat the CPU spike as evidence that malicious code ran
High CPU is a symptom; identify the owning process, baseline, timing and workload before proposing an approved change.
What is the effect of count = count + 1 when count begins at 3?
Increment the stored value by one. Distinguish the observed evidence and its limits from more sweeping conclusions; explain why the alternatives do not follow.
A web client changes its user role display. Who must verify data access?
The trusted server
The current browser role field after its next refresh
The navigation component that hides privileged functions
A user controls browser state and UI. Trusted server-side logic must authorize requests against the authenticated user and resource.
What is a consequence of granting shared administrator credentials?
Poor accountability and excess privilege
Greater accountability because all actions share a known account name
More precise least privilege because one account is easier to configure
Shared privileged logins make accountability difficult and expand the impact of credential exposure. Use individually attributable roles.

exams.title: Security Operations and Reporting Examination — Revised V2
questions: A test host is outside a written scope. What is appropriate?
Do not test it without authorization
Passive tests are permissible without approval because they do not change state
Testing can begin if a DNS name resembles an in-scope asset
Authorization must cover the target and techniques. Do not probe out-of-scope systems, even using seemingly read-only tools.
You find one unsuccessful authentication event. What is established?
One failure was recorded; cause remains uncertain
The record confirms a password compromise occurred
The record establishes the user intentionally entered wrong credentials
A failed login event proves the recorded authentication outcome only. Determine identity, cause and intent through corroborating evidence.
What should a professional finding include?
Reproducible authorized evidence, impact and remediation
A vulnerability classification and its presumed worst-case impact
A scanner result without steps to reproduce or validate it
A useful finding links scoped evidence, observed conditions, business impact, correction and measurable retest criteria.
Who typically configures application access in a cloud deployment?
The application owner
The infrastructure provider defines all custom application access roles
The browser enforces data grants without server checks
Under shared responsibility, application owners generally configure their own users, privileges and access policy.
A purported supplier changes banking details via email. What is the safest response?
Verify over a known independent channel
Verify by replying to the same email conversation
Use the invoice attachment to validate the proposed new bank details
A compromised email thread may present consistent false claims. Verify changes using previously established independent contact information.
What does a remediation verification establish?
Whether the affected condition was actually resolved
That no future incident is possible
That no testing is needed
Closure requires evidence and acknowledgement of limits. Distinguish the observed evidence and its limits from more sweeping conclusions; explain why the alternatives do not follow.

exams.title: Enterprise Identity and Linux Administration Exam — Revised V2
questions: A service account backs up one project. What permission is most appropriate?
Write to the required backup destination only
Project-wide administrator access for the backup schedule
Read and write access to every project's source and destination
A service identity needs narrowly scoped destination permissions for its job, with restoration and administrator access separately governed.
An employee leaves but active sessions remain. What is required?
Revoke applicable sessions and access
Disable interactive login but leave current tokens active until expiry
Change the employee's displayed name and preserve delegated sessions
Account offboarding also requires revocation of sessions, delegated access and relevant credentials, not merely a profile update.
On a typical Linux file, what does mode 640 allow its group?
Read but not write
Full execution and modification
No access
The middle digit 4 represents group read permission. Distinguish the observed evidence and its limits from more sweeping conclusions; explain why the alternatives do not follow.
What is a sensible pre-update control?
Backup and test with rollback plan
Disable every security alert
Apply changes to production without review
Maintenance requires validation and recovery planning. Distinguish the observed evidence and its limits from more sweeping conclusions; explain why the alternatives do not follow.
A service consumes high CPU at its scheduled backup time. Best inference?
Investigate context before diagnosing compromise
Restart the backup process and assume its CPU usage is malicious
Assume the scheduling correlation proves all behavior is authorized
Time-of-day correlation is useful context but not proof. Review job ownership, workload and logs before asserting a cause.
What is a useful access audit record?
Grant, approver, purpose, and review date
Plaintext password
Unrelated personal documents

Audit evidence should explain who authorized access without collecting secrets. Distinguish the observed evidence and its limits from more sweeping conclusions; explain why the alternatives do not follow.

exams.title: Web Application and Cloud Security Exam — Revised V2
questions: Who must decide whether a student can read another student's grades?
Trusted API or database rules
Browser session storage after it receives the displayed role
A menu element hidden by client code for nonadministrators
The server or data layer must enforce authorization. Client-side display or flags can be modified and are not trust boundaries.
What reduces database query injection risks?
Parameterized queries
Client-only validation of what a user types into a form
Escaping characters manually inside concatenated SQL statements
Prepared parameterized queries separate parameters from SQL grammar and reduce injection risk in values. Proper authorization still matters.
A browser uses automatically sent session cookies for modifying requests. What threat deserves consideration?
Cross-site request forgery
Session fixation even when session IDs are rotated correctly
Clickjacking even when the page cannot be framed
Automatically included session cookies enable CSRF in some state-changing workflows absent suitable anti-CSRF controls.
Where should privileged service credentials reside?
Restricted server-side secret storage
An encrypted string shipped inside the public JavaScript bundle
A secret value embedded in a publicly downloadable source map
Anything delivered to browsers is exposed to users. Keep privileged credentials in restricted server-side secret storage.
What does RPO describe?
Acceptable data loss measured in time
The maximum acceptable time the service can remain unavailable
The interval between backup jobs irrespective of data loss
RPO quantifies acceptable loss of recent data measured back from failure; RTO instead measures restoration-time limits.
Why separate public materials from private submissions?
Different data classes require different access controls
To change typography
So everyone can administer the database
Classification guides effective grants. Distinguish the observed evidence and its limits from more sweeping conclusions; explain why the alternatives do not follow.

exams.title: Security Assessment and Executive Reporting Exam — Revised V2
questions: A production endpoint is not in the authorized assessment scope. What next?
Request scope approval and refrain from testing
Perform a read-only connectivity check before requesting scope approval
Test only the endpoint's public status page to infer permission
An endpoint absent from written scope must not be tested until approval expands the engagement.
An analyst has a synthetic screenshot of a denied grade request. What is established?
The simulated request was denied
All production records are protected from this class of request
The simulated screenshot proves the real service has no alternate access paths
Synthetic evidence supports only the observed simulation. It cannot certify production authorization or other resources.
Which finding is most reproducible?
Named asset, observed condition, method, impact, and retest
A severity rating and a claim about systemic insecurity
A vendor advisory without an affected asset or retest method
Reproducible findings identify scope, asset, steps, exact observations, impact, mitigation and a retest.
A patch was installed. What is necessary for closure?
Authorized verification of the original issue and functionality
Delete the ticket
Assume all risks vanished
Retesting checks the outcome and regressions. Distinguish the observed evidence and its limits from more sweeping conclusions; explain why the alternatives do not follow.
Two findings share a severity score. How should they be prioritized?
Exposure and business impact
Alphabetical order
Length of vulnerability name
Operational risk is contextual. Distinguish the observed evidence and its limits from more sweeping conclusions; explain why the alternatives do not follow.
What does a board-level report need?
Options, evidenced impact, tradeoffs, and uncertainty
Only raw logs
Guarantee of zero future incidents
Executives need decision-ready information. Distinguish the observed evidence and its limits from more sweeping conclusions; explain why the alternatives do not follow.

exams.title: Ethical Hacking Hardware Knowledge Examination — Revised V2
questions: A hardware tool is capable of radio transmission. What determines whether a specific use is permissible?
Applicable law, authorized scope and operating constraints
The manufacturer's marketing description of typical intended use
Retail purchase and possession of the device
Legal and authorized boundaries apply irrespective of tool capability, availability or intended application.
Which statement best describes a browser-only hardware exercise?
Conceptual simulation, not proof of physical operation
Proof of competent operation on the physical device
A reproducible calibration record from a laboratory instrument
Browser exercises establish reasoning in a simulation, not verified equipment-operation skill.
A fictional RFID reader accepts any matching card identifier. What's the concern?
Identifier-only checks may not prove possession of a protected credential
Proof that the presented card holds a cryptographic credential
An assurance that a displayed identifier cannot be copied
Static identifiers may be replayed or copied. Authentication strength depends on cryptographic proof and implementation.
A USB device appears as a new keyboard. Which defensive idea is relevant?
Device-control policies and endpoint event review
DNS filtering as the primary control against unexpected keyboard devices
Data retention policies on centralized backup servers
Unexpected USB input devices require endpoint awareness, controlled peripheral policies and event investigation.
A sample digital trace changes at 12 μs and 20 μs. What is the interval?
8 μs
32 μs
240 μs
20 minus 12 equals eight microseconds. Distinguish the observed evidence and its limits from more sweeping conclusions; explain why the alternatives do not follow.
An SDR student's antenna is connected but transmission parameters are unknown. What is safest?
Use offline synthetic data and verify compliance before live RF tests
Transmit on an apparently quiet frequency without documented approval
Increase output power until the authorized receiver responds
RF use is constrained by regulations and interference risk. Use simulated or shielded authorized environments until compliance is verified.
A firmware package comes from an unverified link. What should the learner do?
Verify publisher, provenance and integrity
Assume a device driver cannot be harmful
Disable all system protection
Firmware is software and may affect device trust. Distinguish the observed evidence and its limits from more sweeping conclusions; explain why the alternatives do not follow.
An approved wired appliance lab connects to a switch. What should be documented?
Ports, topology, boundaries, expected traffic and shutdown procedure
Nearby private passwords
Unrelated employee profiles
A controlled lab needs clear scope and safety controls. Distinguish the observed evidence and its limits from more sweeping conclusions; explain why the alternatives do not follow.

exams.title: Windows Linux and Network Troubleshooting Exam — Revised V2
questions: 192.168.40.25/24 belongs to which network?
A /24 uses the first three octets for the network prefix. Distinguish the observed evidence and its limits from more sweeping conclusions; explain why the alternatives do not follow.
What is the conventional broadcast address of 192.168.40.0/24?
The final eight host bits are ones in the broadcast address. Distinguish the observed evidence and its limits from more sweeping conclusions; explain why the alternatives do not follow.
The gateway responds but the hostname does not resolve. Which next check is most focused?
Compare resolver configuration and DNS results
Change the default gateway before checking the configured DNS server
Investigate browser content caching before testing name resolution
When IP connectivity works but names fail, examine resolver settings and DNS lookup results before touching routing.
What access does file mode 640 grant the group on an ordinary Linux file?
Read only
Read and write
Execute only
The group digit 4 grants read access. Distinguish the observed evidence and its limits from more sweeping conclusions; explain why the alternatives do not follow.
A Windows sign-in failure appears in Event Viewer. What can be concluded?
A failed authentication event was recorded
Credentials were stolen
Malware was installed
An event's recorded outcome does not establish malicious intent. Distinguish the observed evidence and its limits from more sweeping conclusions; explain why the alternatives do not follow.
What is a good method for studying an unfamiliar Windows startup program?
Review publisher, expected role and authorized device records
Disable the startup item immediately to see whether the machine improves
Assume an unknown name demonstrates an unauthorized persistence mechanism
Observe the publisher, path, signed identity, expected function and context before modifying startup behavior.
Which is the best verification after an approved firewall change?
Confirm intended traffic works and denied traffic stays blocked
Check only that the new firewall rule was saved successfully
Confirm allowed traffic and infer untested denied paths must also be blocked
Effective firewall validation requires positive allowed and negative denied tests within permitted lab boundaries.
What is a correct interpretation of the academy's simulated Linux terminal?
It models selected commands without operating the phone's real shell
A real operating-system shell running with the iPhone's privileges
A live connection to the learner's roommate's device
The simulator interprets a limited set of training commands locally; it cannot execute real shell commands or inspect external computers.
